name: Minghan Wang
bio: I am a PhD candidate in Computer Science at Monash University, supervised by Gholamreza Haffari, Ehsan Shareghi, and Thuy-Trang Vu. My research focuses on intelligent, efficient, and interactive AI systems, with an emphasis on language model reasoning and time-sensitive applications.

I study how language models can reason efficiently in continuous spaces, perceive the passage of time, and interact under real-time constraints. My broader interests include multimodal and multilingual generation, speech translation, and real-time agents.
Before my PhD, I worked on machine translation and speech technologies at Huawei. I received my Master of Science in Computer Science from the University of Melbourne.
